name: Diffusion Approximation
definition: An approximation for multiple scattering in participating media that expresses medium radiance as the first two angular moments (fluence and flux) of the radiation field, solving for the fluence field to determine in-scattering.
summary: Diffusion Approximation replaces the Radiative Transport Equation with a partial differential equation to efficiently model multiple scattering in dense media, distinct from angular or stochastic methods.
